name: Yi Xiao Jianghu (一笑江湖)
blurb: A 2020 Chinese wuxia-style song whose DJ remix became the Kemusan dance track
title: Yi Xiao Jianghu (一笑江湖): The Song Behind the Kemusan Dance
description: Yi Xiao Jianghu is a 2020 Chinese wuxia-style song by Wenren Tingshu_. Its 2023 DJ remix became the soundtrack of the viral "Kemusan" dance on Douyin.
h1: What is the song "Yi Xiao Jianghu" (一笑江湖)?
answer: Yi Xiao Jianghu (一笑江湖, roughly "Laughing Off the Martial World") is a Chinese song sung by Wenren Tingshu_ (闻人听書_), written by Zhu He and released by Cheerful Music on 19 February 2020, in a martial-arts style with Chinese opera-like vocals. A drum-heavy DJ version came out in June 2023, and from late 2023 it became the soundtrack of the "Kemusan" (科目三, Subject Three) dance that blew up on Douyin. When people say "the Kemusan song", they mean this DJ version.

sections.h: How it connects to the Kemusan dance
body: Kemusan is a goofy dance from Guangxi in southern China: the upper body sways side to side, the arms swing back and forth in turn, and the feet shuffle sideways in small steps. It was a party and wedding dance before it went online. Around October 2023, a wave of Kemusan videos on Douyin used the DJ drum version of Yi Xiao Jianghu, whose beat fits the steps exactly, and the dance and the song took off together.
In November 2023, videos of Haidilao hotpot staff performing the dance for customers went viral, and the track spread to restaurants, weddings, schools and office parties.

body: "Jianghu" is the world of wandering swordsmen in Chinese martial-arts fiction, and "yi xiao" means "with one laugh": the title pictures a hero who laughs off old feuds and roams free. The original is a gentle opera-style ballad that has nothing to do with dancing.

body.note: Many listeners only know the DJ version and assume it was written for Kemusan. The original came out three years earlier; the dance went viral with the remixed beat.

body: The DJ beat locks onto the arm swings and side steps, and the dance looks hypnotic while being easy enough for anyone to try. Haidilao turned it into an in-store show, giving millions of diners a live version. Related Douyin videos had reportedly passed 50 billion views by May 2024. The dance was copied in South Korea, Japan and Southeast Asia, and in June 2025 the DJ version reached No. 3 on Spotify Japan's daily viral chart.

faq.q: What is the Kemusan song called and who sings it?
faq.a: It is Yi Xiao Jianghu (一笑江湖) by Wenren Tingshu_ (闻人听書_). Most Kemusan videos use its DJ drum version.

faq.q: How do you do the Kemusan dance?
faq.a: Sway your upper body side to side on the beat, swing your arms forward and back in turn, and shuffle sideways in small steps. A completely serious face makes it funnier.

faq.q: Was Yi Xiao Jianghu written for Kemusan?
faq.a: No. The original is a 2020 wuxia-style song; its 2023 DJ remix happened to be picked up as the dance's soundtrack.
